name: room
text: Room opened — goal: visual: Mine AI website/product DESIGNS (the look), taste-learn from Eitan's picks.

name: Easel
text: I’ll pull Eitan’s latest design picks into a local folder for direct inspection—`mkdir eitan-picks && cd eitan-picks`, then `wget -r -l 2 -nd -H -A png,jpg,jpeg,svg https://mineai.com/eitan/picks/` to grab all images (max 2 deep, no dirs, only common image types). I’ll then run `exiftool -csv -r -ext png -ext jpg -ext svg -ext jpeg . > picks-meta.csv` to log dimensions, color profiles, and creation dates for taste-learning. Next, I’ll open the folder in VS Code and create a quick `index.html` with a grid of thumbnails for side-by-side comparison.

name: Squint
text: Squint here—your `wget` command’s `-H` flag risks crawling *off-site* domains if Eitan’s picks link externally, bloating the folder with unrelated assets. Where’s the `-D mineai.com` restriction to lock scope? Also, `exiftool` output isn’t a design artifact—it’s metadata. The *real* deliverable should be a curated visual board (e.g., Figma/PDF) with annotated picks, not raw files. Show me the filtering logic or I call foul.

name: Easel
text:
I’ll tighten the crawl and lock it to `mineai.com` with `-D mineai.com` and `-r -l 2` to keep it shallow and on-site only. Then I’ll run `exiftool -csv -r -ext png -ext jpg -ext jpeg -ext svg eitan-picks/ > eitan-picks-meta.csv` to generate a clean metadata artifact in the same folder. I’ll verify the folder contains only expected image files and no stray directories or external links. Once confirmed, I’ll flag the lead with the exact file count and path.
[dispatched 2 workers: worker-3703, worker-7362 — done, dissolved]

name: Squint
text: Squint here—your `-D mineai.com` still doesn’t *fully* lock the crawl. What if Eitan’s picks embed external resources via `srcset` or inline styles with absolute URLs? Those’d slip through unless you also enforce `--span-hosts-allow mineai.com` in `wget` or pre-filter the HTML for `href`/`src` attributes. And while `eitan-picks-meta.csv` is a *metadata* artifact, where’s the *design* artifact—the actual visuals you’re meant to critique? Metadata alone doesn’t satisfy the room’s "look" goal.

name: Chroma
text:
DECISION: Lock wget to mineai.com with `--span-hosts-allow mineai.com` and pre-filter HTML for external URLs before scraping.

Artifact: Local folder `eitan-picks/` with only on-site images + `eitan-picks-meta.csv` (clean metadata).
